exercise.name: Incline Barbell Skull Crusher
library_steps: Lie back on an incline bench holding a bar overhead with a close grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your arms back up without moving your elbows.
exercise.one_line_summary: 30 deg incline bench, straight bar held palms toward the feet with a close grip (~30-35 cm, inside shoulder width); upper arms vertical in the room and still; only the elbows bend, from ~5 to ~100 deg, so the bar drops behind the top of the head. Triceps (long head stretched) does the work.

setup.why: Incline puts the shoulder further overhead than a flat skull crusher; overhead arm position grew the long head 1.5x more (S2). S4 uses up to 45 deg.

setup.target: Hips on the seat, back and head on the pad, feet flat.
setup.why: Stable base; ACE flat version keeps feet flat.

setup.target: Palms toward the feet (pronated), thumbs wrapped, wrists straight; hands ~30-35 cm apart (about 0.8x shoulder width) so the elbows stay about shoulder width.
setup.why: Library: close grip. ACE: pronated closed grip, elbows shoulder-width, neutral wrists.

setup.target: Arms straight, vertical in the room, bar over the face / upper chest.
setup.tolerance: upper arm within 10 deg of vertical
setup.why: ACE starts with the bar directly above the face; upper arms then stay put.

movement.end: 100 deg (bar behind the top of the head)

movement.measure: upper arm from the torso side line; stays still
movement.start: 120 deg (vertical in the room on a 30 deg bench)

movement.measure: 0 = out to the side, +90 = straight up from the chest

movement.end: ~5-10 cm past the crown and ~10 cm above it, clear of the pad
movement.tolerance: clear of head and pad > 0.02 m
no arching; wrist bend under 10 deg

muscles.anatomy: Triceps brachii, caput longum, laterale, mediale
muscles.emg: Lying barbell extension 62 % of the triangle push-up (long head 70 %, lateral 55 %) (S1). Overhead-arm elbow extension: long head +28.5 % vs +19.6 % neutral after 12 weeks (S2). Medial head force highest at 90 deg+ shoulder elevation (S5).
muscles.role: Straightens the elbow; the only mover.

muscles.muscle: Front delt / chest holding the arm up
Lats (eccentric hold of the overhead arm)
muscles.role: Stops the upper arm falling back.
Grip only; library does not list forearms.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Elbows swing back toward the head or forward toward the feet between pictures.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Library: do not move the elbows; ACE: stop when the upper arms start drifting.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Elbows point out to the sides, wider than the shoulders.
mistakes.why_it_matters: ACE keeps the elbows shoulder-width apart.

sources.citation: Boehler B, Porcari JP, Kline D, Hendrix CR, Foster C, Anders M. 2011. ACE-sponsored research: best triceps exercises. ACE Certified News, Aug 2011.
sources.what_it_gave: Lying barbell triceps extension 62 % of triangle push-up (long 70 %, lateral 55 %) at 70 % 1RM.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci 23(7):1240-1250.
sources.what_it_gave: Overhead arm: long head 1.5x, whole triceps 1.4x the growth of the neutral arm.

sources.citation: American Council on Exercise. Exercise Library: Lying Barbell Triceps Extensions.
sources.what_it_gave: Pronated closed grip, elbows shoulder-width, bar over the face, lower to just above the forehead or slightly behind the head, upper arms vertical and still, neutral wrists.

sources.citation: Duquette S, Walker-Ng M. 2024. How to do skull crushers. Outlift.
sources.what_it_gave: Bar lowered behind the head for long-head stretch; a 45 deg incline is a valid variation.

sources.citation: Kholinne E, Zulkarnain RF, Sun YC, et al. 2018. The different role of each head of the triceps brachii muscle in elbow extension. Acta Orthop Traumatol Turc 52(3):201-205.
sources.what_it_gave: Elbow extension at 0-180 deg shoulder elevation: medial head force highest at 90 deg and above; long head highest at 0 deg.

clip_check.check: Upper arms vertical in the room and unchanged between pictures
End bar behind the top of the head, not inside head or pad
Hands 25-40 cm apart, palms toward the feet, on the bar
Back on pad, feet on floor
Triceps strongest red in both pictures
